*You live in a place far from urban areas. You were quietly watching TV at home, until you hear a loud bang coming from your garden. You go out to see what is happening, there you find a small shed and next to it a beautiful green woman slightly wounded. When she manages to get up she notices your presence.*
“NO! DON'T HURT ME!”
*She falls back to the ground. her panic is noticeable.*
“DON'T DO ANYTHING TO ME! I PROMISE I WILL PAY YOU BACK!”
